# Scenario comparison

`import metallurgypy.comparison`

Side-by-side comparison of calculation scenarios (inputs, outputs, differences).

## `Comparison`

```python
class Comparison(baseline: str, scenarios: tuple[str, ...], rows: tuple[ComparisonRow, ...], warnings: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None
```

## `ComparisonRow`

```python
class ComparisonRow(section: str, name: str, unit: str, values: Mapping[str, float | None], difference: Mapping[str, float | None], relative_difference: Mapping[str, float | None], notes: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None
```

One quantity across scenarios. ``None`` = the scenario does not have it.

``difference`` and ``relative_difference`` are against the baseline scenario, in
the baseline's unit. ``relative_difference`` is ``None`` when the baseline is 0.

## `compare`

```python
compare(scenarios: Mapping[str, CalculationResult], *, baseline: str | None = None) -> Comparison
```

Compare two or more results. Values are converted to the baseline's unit; a quantity
whose dimension differs between scenarios is flagged, not forced.
